target.title: feat(web): restore the last project location

scenario.action: Open /p/cezar/git?qa=fresh-7aec#changed and wait for the last-location debounce.
scenario.expected: The exact project, pathname, query string, and fragment are persisted.
scenario.observed: The workspace UI-state API returned projectId cezar, pathname /p/cezar/git, search ?qa=fresh-7aec, and hash #changed.

scenario.action: Navigate to the exact bare root and then use browser Back.
scenario.expected: The root is replaced by the saved Git location and does not remain as a transient history entry.
scenario.observed: The URL restored to /p/cezar/git?qa=fresh-7aec#changed; browser Back remained on that exact URL.

scenario.action: Open an explicit project Agents settings URL, visit global Settings, switch to 390 x 844, and navigate to the bare root.
scenario.expected: The explicit URL stays authoritative, global Settings does not overwrite it, and the exact project route restores in a usable mobile layout.
scenario.observed: Workspace UI state remained /p/cezar/settings/agents?manual=fresh-7aec#config while global Settings was open; the bare root restored that exact URL and the Agents pane rendered without page or console errors.

scenario.action: Seed a structurally valid saved route for a removed project and navigate to the bare root.
scenario.expected: The stale project location is ignored and startup falls back to the boot project.
scenario.observed: The URL became /p/42766454-3ead-4ea4-8f05-aab273e5cf8b/ and the boot-project Tasks empty state rendered without page or console errors.

notes: The test environment used CEZ_DRY_RUN=1 with an isolated CEZ_HOME, so no real agent credentials or developer workspace state were exercised.
The host /tmp filesystem was inode-quota exhausted. Browser profiles were isolated under /dev/shm; this infrastructure workaround did not alter the application under test.
The run was evidence-only. It did not add qa-approved, and the existing needs-qa gate remains for human sign-off.
No committed browser-level integration test covers this flow; the already-posted follow-up scenario remains applicable.
